precautions: Passive and assisted motion only. Avoid active lifting and sudden movements. Stay inside a comfortable range.

Increase load gradually. Pain should stay mild during and after exercise. Avoid heavy resistance overhead.
Focus on quad activation and swelling control. Perform twice daily. Stop for sharp joint pain or a major increase in swelling.

Perform frequently through the day to centralize symptoms. Avoid prolonged sitting in flexion.
Perform every 2-3 hours to ease postural strain. Keep the motion small and pain free.
No active shoulder abduction or external rotation past 30 deg.
Wean from sling per MD. No sudden lifting > 2 lbs. Avoid active abduction above 90 degrees until scapular control is restored. No aggressive stretching into end-range external rotation.
Avoid impingement positions under heavy resistance. Gradual progression of load; pain must remain below 3/10 during and after exercise.

protocol_title: Acute Lumbar Extension Bias (Discogenic / Flexion Intolerance)
precautions: Avoid loaded lumbar flexion, slouching, and prolonged seated postures. Centralization of symptoms into low back is the primary goal; discontinue if symptoms peripheralize into buttock or leg.

protocol_title: Lumbar Flexion Bias (Spinal Stenosis / Facet Arthropathy)
precautions: Avoid end-range lumbar extension, prolonged standing, and overhead reaching with arched back. Siting or forward leaning should relieve symptoms.
Maintain neutral spine posture; no breath-holding (avoid Valsalva). Discontinue any movement causing sharp back pain or radiating symptoms.

protocol_title: Lumbar Motor Control (Phase 2: Global Endurance & Anti-Movement)
precautions: Emphasize core stiffness and anti-rotational stability over movement speed. Stop before form breaks down into compensatory lumbar extension or rotation.
Avoid wide-stance asymmetric lunging or aggressive unilateral shear forces during acute pain. Keep pelvis level and square during all movements.

criteria: Knee ROM is restored to 95% of the uninvolved knee in supine. Ascend/descend stairs reciprocal pattern without pain or UE assist. 5 steps ups (10" step). 5 lateral step downs (8" step). Squat symmetrically to 90°. Y balance reach 80% of uninvolved side without hip strategy
precautions: Avoid exercises that are painful and cause swelling. Don’t initiate running. Still avoid aggressive PROM into knee flexion Dosing: 2-3 sets of 12-15 reps.

criteria: Knee ROM is restored to 95% of the uninvolved knee. Y balance reach 95% of uninvolved side without hip strategy in supine. 30 lateral step downs (8" step, back flat against wall) with no hip compensation. 15 forward step downs (8" step). 25 SL bridges on bench (knee bent at 20°). 25 SL calf raises (10° incline to 60bpm metronome). 25 SL squats to box (20") with minimal trunk flexion
precautions: Avoid exercises that are painful and cause swelling. Don’t initiate running Dosing: 3 sets of 6-12 reps.

protocol_title: Simple Meniscal Repair (Phase 5: Intro to Impact)
criteria: To Begin Jogging: (Use Strengthlevel.com). 12 reps at 70% of Novice Goblet Squats. 12 reps at 70% of Novice Forward Lunges. 12 reps at 70% of Novice DB RDLs. <30% quad strength deficit for average force with Isometric testing at 60° knee flexion. 15 SL hops in place w/ good load acceptance. & landing in same spot. To Move Onto Phase 6:. ATHLETES: Run 1mi w/o limping. GENERAL POP: Jog 5min w/o limping. Sprint w/o compensation. Land symmetrical <10% difference w/ 5 squat jumps on Force Plates. Decel efficiently in the sagittal plane
precautions: Avoid exercises that are painful and cause swelling. Don’t initiate running until patient has passed the criteria below for return to jogging Dosing: 2-3 sets of 3-5 reps.

criteria: To Begin Cutting: (Use Strengthlevel.com). 8 reps at 80% of Intermediate Goblet Squats. 8 reps at 80% of Intermediate Forward. Lunges. 8 reps at 80% of Intermediate DB RDLs. <20% quad strength deficit for average force with isometric testing at 60° knee flexion. To Move Onto Phase 7:. SL hop test >80% LSI with average of 3 trials. <20% deficit for Deceleration RFD and Peak. Force with landing w/ SL Countermovement. Jump on Force Plates
precautions: Don’t initiate cutting until patient has passed the criteria below for return to cutting Dosing: 3-4 sets of 3-5 reps.

protocol_title: Simple Meniscal Repair (Phase 7: Return to Sport)
criteria: SL hop test >95% LSI with average of 3 trials. Triple hop test >95% LSI with average of 3 trials. <10% quad strength deficit for average force with isometric testing at 60° knee flexion. Girth measurements of the quad within 1 cm of non-surgical limb. Score of 48 or > on the Injury-Psychological. Readiness to Return to Sport (I-PRRS). Questionnaire
0°-90° of knee AROM. 30 consecutive SLR without lag
precautions: NWB w/ crutches for 6 weeks. If patient had meniscus repair limit ROM to 60°. Protect fixation. Increase knee flexion ROM gradually by 10°-15° each week

criteria: Knee ROM is restored to 80% of the uninvolved knee. SLS x 30sec without LOB. Normal gait pattern without AD and with full terminal knee extension
precautions: WBAT to full WB with no AD by 10-12 weeks. Increase amount of weightbearing by ~ 25% each week until full weight bearing Dosing: 2-3 sets of 12-15 reps.

0°-90° of knee AROM. Independent transfers and gait with appropriate AD
precautions: WBAT w/ AD. Monitor wound healing. Monitor for signs of DVT (Pt should be taking at least 81mg aspirin. 2x/day per surgeon prescription). Avoid putting pillows or towel rolls under knee to promote extension

criteria: Knee AROM 0°- 120°. Ambulate >500ft without AD, deviations, or antalgia. SLR 2x10 without extension lag. Sit to stand without UE from 20” surface. Modified Step Up Test: 5 reps, 8" step, UE for balance. Modified LSD Test: 5 reps, 6” step, toe tap strategy, UE for balance. TUG <13sec with appropriate AD
precautions: Monitor wound healing (avoid scar tissue mobilization until wound closed). Monitor for signs of DVT. Avoid putting pillows or towel rolls under knee to promote extension

criteria: Pain free and 90% ROM of uninvolved knee. Symmetrical squat to 20" Box. Reciprocal gait pattern on steps without handrail. 6MWT match norms for age. Get up from floor w/ UE assist if needed. 30sec STS test 17” height: Complete 10 reps. SLS match norms for age:. 30sec <70 y/o, 15sec 70-79 y/o, 10sec >80 y/o
precautions: Avoid sleeping with pillow under knee to promote extension. Avoid standing or walking for long periods to decrease swelling

criteria: Use Strengthlevel.com norms:. Functional Squat test: 10 reps w/ 15lb (f),. 20lb (m) med ball to 18" bench. Functional RDL Test: 10 reps w/ 20lb (f). 25lb (m) med ball from 8" step. Complete 3 minute step test (8") w/o UE support. 30sec STS test 17” height: Complete 15 reps
precautions: Avoid excessive and repetitive impact exercises
